scoring_justification: The agent provides a raw sweep CSV; the checker can recompute the maximum efficiency and output power for each material-geometry combination and compare to paper-reported gold values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for eta_max (%) and Pout_max (mW) for each material-geometry combination
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 2 of the paper: 'Comparison of maximum values of efficiency and output power at ΔT = 560 K'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the published table in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported numbers; they are the target to reproduce.

outputs.description: Full sweep of efficiency and output power vs. load resistance for four combinations (material × geometry) at ΔT = 560 K. The checker will extract the maximum η and maximum Pout for each combination and compare to the paper’s reported values.

output_contract.notes: The simulation must use the material property polynomials exactly as given in the paper (Table 1) and must cover a load resistance range dense enough to resolve the maxima. No external dataset is required; the workflow is entirely compute-driven.

steps.description: Recompute maximum eta and Pout from sweep data and compare to gold references
